title: Farming script for
script:
local NexusLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xyraniz/UI-Libs/main/Librarys/NexusLib/Source.lua"))()
local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Paper.Remotes.__remotefunction
local Function = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Paper.Remotes.__remoteevent
deposit_running = false
eggs_running = false
cash_running = false
merge_running = false
buy_running = false
upgrade_running = false
local Window = NexusLib:Window(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Name, "Egg game whatever", "", Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
local Tab1 = Window:Tab("Farming")
Tab1:Toggle("Auto Collect Eggs", false, function(value)
    eggs_running = value
    while eggs_running do
        for _, egg in ipairs(workspace.Eggs:GetChildren()) do
            Function:FireServer("Collect Egg", egg.Name)
            egg:Destroy()
        end
        task.wait()
    end
end)
Tab1:Toggle("Auto Deposit Eggs", false, function(value)
    deposit_running = value
    while deposit_running do
        Event:InvokeServer(
            "Deposit Eggs"
        )
        task.wait()
    end
end)
Tab1:Toggle("Auto Collect Cash", false, function(value)
    cash_running = value
    while cash_running do
        Event:InvokeServer(
            "Collect Cash"
        )
        task.wait(0.01)
    end
end)
Tab1:Toggle("Auto Buy Chickens", false, function(value)
    buy_running = value
    while buy_running do
        Event:InvokeServer(
            "Buy Chickens",
            1
        )
        task.wait()
    end
end)
Tab1:Toggle("Auto Merge Chickens", false, function(value)
    merge_running = value
    while merge_running do
        Event:InvokeServer("Merge Chickens")
        task.wait()
    end
end)
Tab1:Toggle("Auto Upgrade Machine", false, function(value)
    upgrade_running = value
    while upgrade_running do
        Event:InvokeServer("Upgrade Process Level")
        task.wait()
    end
end)
features:
Auto Collect Eggs
Auto Deposit Eggs
Auto Collect Cash
Auto Buy Chickens
Auto Merge Chickens
Auto Upgrade Machine
